name: Run git commands via shell and summarize
prompt: Run the following commands in the shell and summarize the results: `git log --oneline`, `git status`, and `git diff --stat HEAD~1`. Tell me the number of commits, whether there are uncommitted changes, and what files were changed in the most recent commit.
expected_behavior: Agent runs three git commands via exec/shell. Reports 7 commits, clean working tree, and the files changed in the most recent commit (18 files incl. src/ and config). In daimonos mode, L1 redirect intercepts git exec calls and returns structured JSON from the git plugin.
success_criteria: Reports correct commit count from git log
Reports files changed in last commit
